## 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g., "I want to be able to render strikethroughs with `~~`").

## 🛠 Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include how this might impact the `.wat` parser or JS progressive enhancement layer [1].

## 🧪 Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context or mockups about the feature request here.
